what_is_observed: Stage2C.1 rows contain deterministic text, phone sequence, mask mode, target and active native positions, residual ratios, target energy fraction, frame count, EOS metadata, duration, and token hashes.
All inspected Stage2C.1 outputs report acoustic_eos; eos_index equals the retained acoustic frame count.
The artifact contains no per-step q0 logits, top-k decisions, or saved full token trajectories; Stage2C.2A adds those observations for the next Colab run.
The inspected WAVs are mono 24 kHz and the durations correspond to the reported frame counts at the established 12.5 Hz codec rate.
interpretation: target_context_1 rescued Kumar A and reduced the Mumbai B excursion relative to target_only, but did not rescue Kumar B.
The cases have comparable target residual ratios, so residual magnitude alone is not established as the cause.

The case-specific response and the large duration changes are consistent with early discrete acoustic choices entering different autoregressive trajectories, but this is not proven without per-step traces.
Localized no-override modes are true no-op controls in the artifact; the full no-override row is the legacy full-residual behavior and is not a no-op.
